blind.description: A stylized four-sided obelisk monument featuring a stepped square stone plinth with golden hemispherical studs at each corner. The tapering shaft is made of light beige sandstone, decorated along each face with vertically stacked embossed golden sun medallions. The top is capped with a polished gold pyramidion resting on a metallic collar. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and cleanly modeled in a stylized fantasy or historical game asset aesthetic.
blind.from_above: A square composition showing a central golden square pyramidion pointing upwards, surrounded by the square stepped base with four golden rounded studs at the corners.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: integrated stepped square plinth with corner studs
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.9 times the height of the figure (roughly 5 ft tall), and the base is about 2.5 ft wide.
